+"""RoboLab limited-mode task controller for moving the pink spaghetti spoon.
+
+This file records the camera-guided control used in the episode. It deliberately
+keeps motion in short, inspectable Cartesian chunks and saves each response.
+"""

+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+

+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+
+def observe(name="obs", depth=True):
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="none")
+    folder = RUNS / name
+    o.save(str(folder))
+    (OUT / f"{name}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
+    return o
+
+def pose_now(o=None):
+    if o is None:
+        o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+    return np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], dtype=float)
+
+def joints_now(o=None):
+    if o is None:
+        o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+    return np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
+
+def move_pose(pose, name, video="both"):
+    """Move TCP to [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,gripper], preserving commanded gripper."""
+    a = np.asarray(pose, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 8)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, cameras=["egocentric_mirrored_camera", "over_shoulder_left_camera", "wrist_cam"],
+                   video=video, video_fps=8, note=name)
+    res.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    print(name, json.dumps({k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk", "time_left_s")}), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def move_joint(q, gripper, name, duration=2.0):
+    """Smooth absolute joint interpolation to q and binary gripper state."""
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+    q0 = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
+    q1 = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    n = max(2, int(np.ceil(duration * 15)))
+    a = np.column_stack((np.linspace(q0, q1, n), np.full(n, float(gripper)))).astype(np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=1/15, cameras=["egocentric_mirrored_camera", "over_shoulder_left_camera", "wrist_cam"],
+                   video="both", video_fps=8, note=name)
+    res.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    print(name, json.dumps({k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk", "time_left_s")}), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def run():

+    print("connected", r.base, "time_left", o.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    print("tcp", np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15]), flush=True)
+    print("world", json.dumps(spec["world"]), flush=True)
+
